rows.text_longest:
"Excalibur," also known as the "Sword of Annihilation", and "Tauberg's
Sword" is a chemical laser weapon conceived as a long-range anti-ICBM
defense system.

Excalibur was built under the Ballistic Missile Defence program, which
was intended to safeguard against ICBM attacks in the event of
worldwide nuclear warfare. The concept of an anti-ICBM laser
interception system was eventually chosen as a symbol of the nation's
technological strength.

Excalibur Status: Representative Country

The Granley Mountains are a veritable treasure trove of raw materials
that haven't been utilized. By actually extracting and utilizing these
resources, we can start to strengthen the Gebetian economy and turn it
into a strong trade powerhouse.

USEAN BRIEFING
Refugee pressure: 9999/100. Fallout recovery: 9999/100.
The official chronology records Erusea closing its border to refugees on
21 April 2000 and the invasion of San Salvacion in the summer of 2003.
The indices, choices and any averted or earlier war are provisional
gameplay.

WAR BRIEFING
The stage chain follows the official chronology: ISAF forms on 22 August
2003, falls back to Los Canas, moves its headquarters to North Point,
lands on the continent and destroys Stonehenge. Each stage fires once.
Borders change only through the war itself; stage timings are provisional
gameplay.

Shown only when the Playtest shortcuts game rule is enabled. Each
shortcut runs the same effect as the natural route.
